physics-killer-03.title: Aiki da sauya makamashin inji (Inquiry)
physics-killer-03.goal: Analyze the principles of Aiki da sauya makamashin inji (Inquiry) and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.
physics-killer-03.material: Wani abu mai nauyin $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ yana zamewa daga tsaye a tsayin $4\,\mathrm{m}$ a kan wani fili mai lanƙwasa mara gogayya, sa'an nan ya ratsa wani yanki mai gagararre a kwance (tsawonsa $5\,\mathrm{m}$, girman gogayyar da ke aiki a kan abu tsayayye $11\,\mathrm{N}$), sannan ya hau wani gangare na dama mara gogayya. Idan $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ kuma aka yi watsi da juriyar iska, wane zaɓi ne ya haɗa daidai, bi da bi, kuzarin zafi $Q$ da aka samar a yankin gagararre da mafi girman tsayin da abu ke hawa a gangaren dama?
physics-killer-03.s.s1.prompt: Wani abu mai nauyin $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ yana zamewa daga tsaye a tsayin $4\,\mathrm{m}$ a kan wani fili mai lanƙwasa mara gogayya, sa'an nan ya ratsa wani yanki mai gagararre a kwance (tsawonsa $5\,\mathrm{m}$, girman gogayyar da ke aiki a kan abu tsayayye $11\,\mathrm{N}$), sannan ya hau wani gangare na dama mara gogayya. Idan $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ kuma aka yi watsi da juriyar iska, wane zaɓi ne ya haɗa daidai, bi da bi, kuzarin zafi $Q$ da aka samar a yankin gagararre da mafi girman tsayin da abu ke hawa a gangaren dama?
physics-killer-03.s.s1.explain: Kuzarin inji na farko $E_0=mgh_0=2\cdot10\cdot4=80\,\mathrm{J}$. A yankin gagararre $Q=fs=11\cdot5=55\,\mathrm{J}$ yana canzawa zuwa zafi, don haka kuzarin inji da ya rage $80-55=25\,\mathrm{J}$ ne. Tun da gangaren dama ba shi da gogayya, daga $25=mgh$, $h=\dfrac{25}{2\cdot10}=1.25\,\mathrm{m}$. Idan aka yi watsi da gogayya aka ɗauka abu zai hau $4\,\mathrm{m}$ sai amsa mara kyau ②; idan aka ɗauki kuzarin da ya rage $25\,\mathrm{J}$ a matsayin zafi sai amsa mara kyau ③; idan aka yi amfani da $\frac12mgh$ maimakon $mgh$ sai a sami $2.5\,\mathrm{m}$ (amsa mara kyau ④).
